Enterprise-ready from day one

Isolated data

Every record belongs to your tenant. Cross-tenant access is blocked.

Secure sign-in

Sessions locked to your subdomain; you pick the login options.

Invite-only

Only invited people — or your email domain — can join.

Admin console

Your admins see only your learners and their activity.

Contract billing

Premium for every member. No cards, checkout or upsells.

Seats & limits

Seat caps, usage limits and features set for your firm alone.

Your courses

Career paths point learners to your LMS courses first.

Branded emails

Every notification carries your brand and links to your site.
